voci.titolo: Aggressive Fed rate hikes are quickly becoming the biggest risk to stocks in 2027, says economist
voci.riassunto: The Fed remains too optimistic on its ability to tame inflation, and markets may be too complacent, economist Neil Dutta warns.

voci.titolo: Chile Pension Funds’ Swap Losses Narrow as Treasuries Rally
voci.riassunto: Chilean pension funds narrowed their market-value losses on foreign interest-rate swaps in October as a rally in US Treasuries provided some relief to a system under heavy pressure from politicians to reduce risks and boost payments.

voci.titolo: Corporate America is making a trillion-dollar mistake about retirement
voci.riassunto: The market is dramatically underpricing the economic impact of Americans age 50 and older.

voci.titolo: Pizza Hut Looks to Sell $1 Billion of Bonds to Fund Its Buyout
voci.riassunto: Pizza Hut is looking to sell around $1 billion of bonds backed by its franchise agreements and related fees, to help fund its buyout by private equity firm LongRange Capital LLC.

voci.titolo: Dollar Set for Best Day Since September as CPI Lifts Hike Bets
voci.riassunto: The dollar headed for its strongest gain since September after hotter-than-forecast US inflation reinforced expectations for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike next month.

voci.titolo: Corn Soars After USDA Cuts American Yield in Another Surprise
voci.riassunto: Corn surged the most in three months after the US Department of Agriculture surprised traders with a bigger-than-expected cut to yield and production of America’s most widely grown crop.

voci.titolo: Peloton Draws $6.8 Billion Demand for Debut Junk-Bond Sale
voci.riassunto: Peloton Interactive Inc. has attracted strong investor demand for its debut junk-bond sale, allowing the fitness company to boost the deal’s size and slash borrowing costs.

voci.titolo: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, more than expected, complicating Fed's inflation fight
voci.riassunto: The report comes at a critical juncture for the Federal Reserve as it considers its next move regarding interest rates.

voci.titolo: Fox to Raise $8.4 Billion in Bond Sale to Refinance Roku Deal
voci.riassunto: Fox Corp. is set to raise $8.4 billion from an investment-grade bond sale to help fund its acquisition of Roku Inc., after drawing strong demand for the offering.

voci.titolo: Bond Yields Spike Most Since Tariff Meltdown on Rate-Hike Bets
voci.riassunto: The US bond market tumbled, sending short-term yields surging by the most in 19 months, after consumer prices rose at a faster-than-expected pace and Federal Reserve officials warned the central bank may need to increase interest rates more aggressively.

voci.titolo: China's goods surplus tops $1 trillion for a second year amid calls for Beijing to rebalance trade
voci.riassunto: China's trade surplus topped $1 trillion as of October, potentially intensifying complaints from trading partners already wary over the glut of cheap Chinese goods.

voci.titolo: Gold Tumbles as Hot US Inflation, Fedspeak Fuel Fed Hike Bets
voci.riassunto: Gold extended its decline after a hotter-than-expected US inflation report and remarks from policymakers reinforced bets that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next month.

voci.titolo: 3 unexpected reasons the October jobs report was so strong
voci.riassunto: October's jobs report blew past economist forecasts. Here are three reasons.

voci.titolo: Stocks, Bonds Fall as Fed-Hike Chorus Grows Louder: Markets Wrap
voci.riassunto: Faster-than-estimated inflation data spurred losses in stocks and bonds, with Wall Street also rattled by signals from some Federal Reserve officials that they may need to lift rates more aggressively.

voci.titolo: A key report for where inflation stood in October comes out Tuesday. Here's what to expect
voci.riassunto: The CPI headline reading is expected to show an increase of 0.3% while the core is forecast to increase 0.2%.

voci.titolo: China wholesale inflation hits highest in more than four years as consumer measure slows
voci.riassunto: The PPI for October came in at 5.7%, compared to the 5.3% expected by economists polled by Reuters.

voci.titolo: A disturbing employment trend is hiding beneath the latest strong job numbers
voci.riassunto: The average jobless worker's bout of unemployment surpassed 27 weeks in October, the highest outside of the pandemic period in a decade.
